story.headline: Founded on a Simple Belief
story.body:
Serenity Wellness Center was born in 2015 from founder Elena Chen's personal journey through burnout. After leaving a high-pressure corporate career and rediscovering balance through massage therapy and mindfulness, she knew she had to share this gift with others.

What started as a small studio with just two treatment rooms has grown into Santa Monica's most trusted wellness destination. But our mission remains the same: helping every guest reconnect with their inner calm.

hero.headline: Treatments Designed for Results
hero.subheadline: From quick stress relief to comprehensive wellness packages, we have the perfect service for your needs.
